verdicts.reason: A keeps the label frame and the bottle illustrations along the bottom, so it still reads as the same design. But the headline rules are misplaced: one runs through the gap between J'adore Paris and LAVANDER and sits off to the right, another stray rule floats at the lower right, and the text is small and crooked. B separates the label panel from its text: the panel is an empty white box with a stray dash, and the text sits on the bare background with the brand name pushed to the right edge. The illustrations are shrunk to a tiny strip and a blurry oversized butterfly and cookie fragment appear. B is unusable.
